bands.purpose: warm screen frames and reader edges

prompt: Create a production photorealistic WOOD MATERIAL TEXTURE ATLAS for a high-fidelity spatial website. Output one square image with EXACTLY THREE equally sized horizontal bands, flush touching, no margins, no labels, no borders. Top third: finely sanded western red cedar, warm russet and honey amber with naturally irregular long horizontal wood grain, tasteful occasional thin dark streaks. Middle third: finely sanded western hemlock, pale straw beige with delicate closely spaced straight horizontal grain, calm and consistent. Bottom third: finely sanded bigleaf maple, warm cream and pale golden tan, restrained flowing fine grain with occasional subtle figure. Each band completely fills its third of the image with an uninterrupted close-up flat wood surface; grain runs left to right and should tile horizontally. All surfaces premium furniture grade, smooth satin oil finish, tiny real pores and fiber detail, authentic wood colors. Orthographic overhead macro material scan, even neutral diffuse illumination, uniform color and exposure edge to edge. Absolutely no directional shadows, no highlights painted in, no bevels, no planks or seams, no scenes or objects, no text or watermark. The website will add physical highlights, bevels and blue energy light at runtime. Preserve fine high-resolution grain for 4K/8K displays, highest sharpness and detail.
